facts.audit: The claim was measured on the OLD pack (53,104 rows, packed 11:46 with a stale derived holdout_hashes.txt). The pack was rebuilt at 13:30 after holdout_hashes.txt regeneration (13:18:44); the current pack (46,938 rows, the one v2/v3 actually trained on) was re-probed 2026-08-31 on ALL 500 questions with the same first-24-token exact-subsequence method: 0/500 verbatim. The old pack's 16.6% run stays void; the retraction covers applying this fact to v2 (2.2%) and v3 (40.0%), which trained on the clean rebuild.
